note: Data for tools/rooting/check.py, the rejecting gate for the canonical-rooting directive. The rule vocabulary below parameterises every rejection; the self_test block carries in-repo-independent synthetic fixtures so --self-test and --controls need no network, Lean or Rust build. The governing_documents and source_roots are the --check scan surface. Retired routes are listed with the path prefixes and tokens that must not be presented as the active architecture. A coordinate or hash equality presented as source identity, or an executing address signature that omits Sigma, is a rejected policy and is listed as a retired route.

retired_routes.title: Rejected coordinate/hash identity and Sigma-free executing signature
tokens: omits Sigma from an executing signature

rules.title: Unrooted refinement/execution claim
rules.description: A refinement or execution claim that is import-only or names the canonical material only by path/namespace, with no executing canonical root symbol on the claim line or the line after it.

rules.title: Active retired route
rules.description: A retired route (binned derivation family, generated trace, Run/Derives acceptance, named proof DAG, segment lemma) present in the tree or referenced as active architecture without a retirement marker.

rules.title: New primitive/refinement without a canonical link
rules.description: A declaration introducing a new primitive, refinement or root that names no canonical definition or canonical root symbol.

rules.title: Unqualified complexity claim
rules.description: A complexity claim whose enclosing comment block carries neither the measure counted in nor the derivation AGENTS.md §8 requires (fixed N, bounded callbacks, a nonconstant key length and an explicit no-claim disclaimer remain accepted).

rules.title: Task/ownership declaration over budget or ungated
rules.description: An ownership declaration listing more than three files, or a task declaration that lacks a gate or a negative control.

rules.title: Scan surface incomplete
rules.description: A configured governing document or scan root is missing.

baseline.text:
# Synthetic rooting fixture

The word executor is refined to the canonical `Apeiron.Table.insertWith` through
the executing root `word_table_insert_denote` whose body is extracted from the
real source.

The fixed-shard lookup is O(1) at fixed N with bounded callbacks and a
nonconstant key length.

New primitive `word_table_insert` is linked to canonical
`Apeiron.Table.insertWith`.

Owned files: `a.py`, `b.py`, `c.py`.
GATE: `python3 tools/rooting/check.py --check`.
CONTROL: the mutation MUST fail.

cases.text:
/-- Append `value` once when there is room, otherwise refuse.

Temporal O(n). Spatial O(n): the appended list holds the cells. Operations counted:
list links traversed, cons cells allocated. -/
def syntheticAppend (xs : List Nat) (v : Nat) : List Nat :=
  xs ++ [v]
